description: A 2HP stereo reverb: eight parallel comb filters into four allpass filters for each side, the right side's buffers a little longer than the left's so the tail spreads

params.text: Sets the length of the tail by raising the feedback of the comb filters
Takes more of the high frequencies off the tail with each pass round the comb filters
Crossfades between the dry signal and the reverb, all dry fully counter-clockwise and all wet fully clockwise

inputs.text: The audio into the reverb; with nothing in the R in jack it goes in at full level
Averaged with the L in jack to make the signal fed into the reverb, so a stereo pair is no louder than one side alone

outputs.text: The dry signal crossfaded with the left side's reverb tail
The dry signal crossfaded with the right side's reverb tail, whose filters run a little longer than the left's

notes: mono only: a polyphonic cable at either input is summed down to one channel, and each output carries one channel

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the L in jack alone.
